pack.title: A weekend invitation with two possible dates
pack.ru: Приглашение на выходные с двумя датами
pack.goal: Предложить встречу, уточнить занятость и подтвердить удобную дату.

grammar.title: Would you like / would like to
grammar.rule: Would you like to + глагол — вежливое приглашение; I'd like to + глагол — желание. После would like нужен to перед глаголом.
grammar.pattern: Would you like to join us? / I'd like to come.
grammar.example: Would you like to meet on Sunday afternoon?
grammar.pitfall: Не говори Would you like join us?
exercises: Would you like ___ for a walk on Sunday?
Пригласи: не хочешь ли встретиться завтра?
Would you like to meet tomorrow
I'd like ___ coffee before our walk.
Complete: Would you like to ___ (join) our group?
Скажи: я хотел бы прийти в воскресенье.
I would like to come on Sunday

phrases: Would you like to join us for a walk this weekend?
Не хочешь присоединиться к нам на прогулке в выходные?
Saturday is difficult for me because I have another arrangement.
Суббота мне не подходит, потому что у меня другая договорённость.
Would Sunday afternoon work for you instead?
Вместо этого тебе подойдёт воскресенье после обеда?
I'd like to come if the weather is fine.
Я хотел бы прийти, если погода хорошая.
Let's confirm the date before inviting anyone else.
Подтвердим дату, прежде чем приглашать других.
I can bring something to share at the picnic.
Могу принести что-нибудь для общего пикника.
Where shall we meet before the walk?
Где встретимся перед прогулкой?
Thanks for giving me another possible date.
Спасибо, что предложил другую возможную дату.
I'll check my family plans and reply this evening.
Я проверю семейные планы и отвечу сегодня вечером.
Sunday works well for me, so let's choose that day.
Воскресенье мне подходит, давай выберем этот день.

reading.title: A weekend invitation with two possible dates
paragraphs: Maya wants to invite three friends for a walk near the river at the weekend. She sends a message suggesting Saturday afternoon, but one friend already has a family arrangement. Another friend is free on both days. Maya offers Sunday as an alternative rather than asking everyone to change their existing plans. She asks the first friend whether Sunday afternoon would be convenient.

The friends agree that Sunday works for them. They choose a meeting place near a small bridge and decide to bring something to share at a picnic. Maya checks that the invitation includes the date, time and location. She sends one final message with the confirmed details. The weather may change, so the friends also agree to meet at a café if it rains. Nobody is expected to attend until they have accepted the invitation.
questions: Why is Saturday difficult for one friend?
What will they do if it rains?

dialogue: Maya
Would you like to join us for a walk on Saturday afternoon?
Не хочешь присоединиться к нам на прогулке в субботу после обеда?
Nina
I'd like to, but I have a family arrangement on Saturday.
Я хотела бы, но у меня семейная договорённость на субботу.
Maya
No problem. Would Sunday afternoon work for you instead?
Без проблем. Тебе вместо этого подойдёт воскресенье после обеда?
Nina
Yes, Sunday is free. Where are you thinking of meeting?
Да, воскресенье свободно. Где думаешь встретиться?
Maya
Near the small bridge by the river. We can bring a picnic.
У маленького моста возле реки. Можем устроить пикник.
Nina
That sounds good. I'd like to bring some fruit to share.
Звучит хорошо. Я хотела бы принести немного фруктов для всех.
Maya
Great. Shall we meet there at two?
Отлично. Встретимся там в два?
Nina
Two is perfect. Let me know if the plan changes.
Два — отлично. Сообщи, если план изменится.
listening: What time do Maya and Nina agree to meet?
speaking: Invite a friend to a weekend activity using would you like to.
Decline one date politely and suggest another.
Explain the difference between a suggested date and a confirmed date.
Confirm a meeting point and time in one short message.
Role-play changing a picnic plan because of rain.
writing: Write a friendly invitation with two possible dates.
Write a polite reply accepting one date and confirming the location.
Write four invitations and four suitable replies using would like.
pack.model: Would you like to join us for a walk? Saturday is difficult for me, but Sunday afternoon works. Shall we meet near the bridge at two?

competency.canDo: Предложить встречу, уточнить занятость и подтвердить удобную дату.
competency.successCriteria: Form invitations with would like to; negotiate and confirm a date.

checks: Would you like ___ the exhibition with us?
Complete: I'd like to ___ (meet) you after lunch.
A friend says Saturday is difficult. Which response respects that?
You must change your other plan.
Offer an alternative without inventing agreement.

pack.title: Packing for a two-day countryside trip
pack.ru: Сбор вещей для двухдневной поездки за город
pack.goal: Собрать вещи, оценить количество и договориться, кто что возьмёт.

grammar.title: Countable and uncountable quantities
grammar.rule: A few + исчисляемые существительные во множественном числе; a little + неисчисляемые. Enough + noun — достаточное количество.
grammar.pattern: a few shirts / a little water / enough food
grammar.example: We need a few warm shirts and a little cooking oil.
exercises: We need ___ clean shirts for the trip.
Complete: Take ___ (a little / a few) cooking oil.
Скажи: у нас достаточно еды на два дня.
We have enough food for two days
There are only ___ spare socks in the bag.
Complete: We have ___ (a few / a little) space left.

phrases: We only need a few clothes for two days.
На два дня нам нужно всего несколько вещей.
Is there enough room for both towels?
Достаточно места для обоих полотенец?
I'll bring a little cooking oil in a small container.
Возьму немного растительного масла в маленьком контейнере.
Can you pack the spare charging cable?
Можешь положить запасной кабель зарядки?
Let's divide the shared items between our bags.
Разделим общие вещи между нашими сумками.
I need a lightweight jacket in case of rain.
Мне нужна лёгкая куртка на случай дождя.
There is a little space left beside the shoes.
Рядом с обувью осталось немного места.
We don't need to carry two copies of everything.
Не нужно нести по два экземпляра каждой вещи.
Could you check the bag weight limit before packing?
Проверь ограничение веса сумки перед сборами.
I'll add the missing items to our packing list.
Добавлю недостающие вещи в наш список.

reading.title: Packing for a two-day countryside trip
paragraphs: Rosa and her friend are going to spend two days in a small countryside guesthouse. They plan to travel by bus and walk from the village stop, so they want to carry light bags. Rosa makes a list of clothes, toiletries and shared food items. She checks the weather forecast and adds a light rain jacket and a warm layer. Her friend already has a towel and a phone charger.

They compare their lists before packing. They need a few spare socks, enough drinking water for the walk and a little cooking oil for the guesthouse kitchen. Rosa offers to carry the food container while her friend takes the towels and charging cable. They check the bag weight and remove two things they do not need. Finally, they save the shared packing list on both phones so they can check it again before leaving.
questions: How will they reach the guesthouse area?
To divide shared items and avoid duplication
What does Rosa offer to carry?

dialogue: Rosa
We only have two days away. Shall we make a shared packing list?
У нас всего два дня поездки. Составим общий список вещей?
Friend
Yes. I have a towel and a charger already.
Да. У меня уже есть полотенце и зарядка.
Rosa
Good. I'll bring a few spare socks and a lightweight jacket.
Хорошо. Возьму несколько запасных носков и лёгкую куртку.
Friend
Do we have enough space for food and water?
У нас достаточно места для еды и воды?
Rosa
Yes, if we use a small container. We only need a little cooking oil.
Да, если используем маленький контейнер. Нужно совсем немного масла.
Friend
I'll carry the towels and the spare charging cable.
Я понесу полотенца и запасной кабель зарядки.
Rosa
Let's check the total bag weight before we leave.
Проверим общий вес сумок перед выходом.
Friend
Agreed. I'll remove the extra shoes from my bag.
Согласен. Уберу лишнюю обувь из сумки.
speaking: List countable and uncountable things for an overnight trip.
Use a few, a little and enough to describe your luggage.
Agree with a friend who carries three shared items.
Explain why you removed an unnecessary item.
Role-play checking the packing list before a bus journey.
writing: Write a packing list with quantities for a two-day visit.
Write six quantity sentences using a few, a little and enough.
Write a message assigning shared items to two travellers.
pack.model: We need a few clean shirts, a little cooking oil and enough water. I'll carry the food container. Could you bring the towels?

competency.canDo: Собрать вещи, оценить количество и договориться, кто что возьмёт.
competency.successCriteria: Use quantity phrases correctly and coordinate a realistic packing list.

checks: Complete: There is ___ (a little / a few) milk left.
Both travellers have packed the same charger. What can they do?
Agree which one to bring and keep enough charging capacity.
Assume the guesthouse provides every item.

pack.title: A guesthouse with a shared kitchen
pack.goal: Уточнить правила общей кухни и договориться о пользовании.

grammar.title: Have to / can for facilities
grammar.rule: Have to + начальная форма выражает необходимость; can + начальная форма — разрешение или возможность. В вопросе: Do I have to...? Can I...?
grammar.example: Do we have to wash the dishes before leaving?
exercises: Guests ___ label food they leave in the fridge. It is required.
Do we have to clean the table
She ___ to return the kitchen key.
Complete: We ___ (can) cook here until nine.
Can does not change by subject.

phrases: Can guests use the kitchen in the evening?
Могут гости пользоваться кухней вечером?
Do we have to label the food in the fridge?
Нам нужно подписывать продукты в холодильнике?
Which shelf is available for our room?
Какая полка доступна для нашего номера?
The communal table must be clean after use.
Общий стол должен быть чистым после использования.
Where is the food waste bin?
Где контейнер для пищевых отходов?
Can I borrow a saucepan from this cupboard?
Могу взять кастрюлю из этого шкафа?
We have to return the kitchen key at reception.
Нужно вернуть ключ от кухни на стойку.
Is the kitchen open before breakfast?
Кухня открыта перед завтраком?
I'll wash the dishes before we go out.
Помою посуду, прежде чем мы уйдём.
Please let us know which supplies are shared.
Сообщите, какие принадлежности общие.

reading.title: A guesthouse with a shared kitchen
paragraphs: Leo and his friend arrive at a guesthouse in a village. Their room has no kitchen, but guests can use a shared kitchen on the ground floor. They have brought food for a simple breakfast and want to store it overnight. The host shows them a fridge with labelled shelves. Each room has a shelf, and guests have to write their room number on containers that they leave there.

The host also explains that the kitchen is open from seven in the morning until nine in the evening. Guests can use the basic cooking equipment, but they have to wash their dishes and clean the table afterwards. Leo asks where the food waste bin is and whether there is a separate charge for kitchen access. There is no charge. He thanks the host, labels his food and leaves the shared area tidy.
questions: What must guests write on containers?
Is there a separate access charge?
It is not possible to use the kitchen

dialogue: Leo
Can we use the shared kitchen to prepare breakfast?
Можем пользоваться общей кухней, чтобы приготовить завтрак?
Host
Yes. It opens at seven in the morning and closes at nine in the evening.
Да. Она открывается в семь утра и закрывается в девять вечера.
Leo
Do we have to label the food we put in the fridge?
Нужно подписывать продукты, которые кладём в холодильник?
Host
Yes. Please write your room number and use the shelf for room six.
Да. Укажите номер комнаты и пользуйтесь полкой для шестого номера.
Leo
Can I use the saucepan in this cupboard?
Могу воспользоваться кастрюлей в этом шкафу?
Host
Certainly. You have to wash it and return it after use.
Конечно. Нужно помыть её и вернуть после использования.
Leo
Is there an extra charge for kitchen access?
Есть дополнительная плата за доступ к кухне?
Host
No, it is included. Please leave the area clean for the next guests.
Нет, доступ включён. Оставляйте место чистым для следующих гостей.
listening: Which room shelf should Leo use?
speaking: Ask a host about three shared kitchen rules.
Explain which tasks are required and which are permitted.
Describe how you would label food in a shared fridge.
Ask about kitchen opening hours and charges.
Role-play confirming kitchen access for an early breakfast.
writing: Write a guesthouse message asking about shared cooking facilities.
Write three have to sentences and three can sentences about kitchen rules.
Write a short notice for guests describing how to leave the shared kitchen.
pack.model: Can we use the kitchen at seven? Do we have to label our food? We'll wash the dishes and clean the table after breakfast.

competency.prerequisites: Can requests, necessity with have to, time expressions
competency.canDo: Уточнить правила общей кухни и договориться о пользовании.
competency.successCriteria: Ask and communicate clear permissions and requirements.

checks: Guests ___ use the shared microwave. It is permitted.
Complete: He ___ (have to) wash his cup after use.
The host assigns fridge shelves by room number. What should you ask if your shelf is full?
Which other space may I use?
Can I remove another guest's food without asking?

pack.title: A walking trail that is shorter than expected
pack.goal: Сравнить маршруты и описать пройденный путь.

grammar.title: Adverbs of manner and adjectives
grammar.rule: Прилагательные описывают существительные; наречия часто образуются с -ly и описывают действия. Good → well; fast и hard имеют особые формы.
grammar.example: We walked slowly along the wet path.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори walk careful, когда описываешь действие в стандартном английском.
exercises: We walked ___ because the path was wet.
Скажи: мы шли медленно вдоль реки.
We walked slowly along the river
It was a ___ route through the woods.
Complete: She checked the signs ___ (careful, adverb).

phrases: The trail was shorter than we expected.
Тропа оказалась короче, чем ожидали.
We walked carefully because the gravel was wet.
Мы шли осторожно, потому что гравий был мокрым.
The information board shows a circular route.
На информационном стенде указан круговой маршрут.
Could you explain the route to the viewpoint clearly?
Можете ясно объяснить путь к смотровой площадке?
We followed the marked path rather than a shortcut.
Мы следовали обозначенной тропе, а не срезали путь.
The signs were clear at every trail junction.
На каждой развилке были понятные указатели.
I prefer a quiet walk at a steady pace.
Предпочитаю спокойную прогулку в устойчивом темпе.
We stopped briefly to read the distance marker.
Мы ненадолго остановились, чтобы прочитать указатель расстояния.
The return route is marked with a yellow arrow.
Обратный маршрут отмечен жёлтой стрелкой.
I'll describe how we completed the circular walk.
Я опишу, как мы прошли круговой маршрут.

reading.title: A walking trail that is shorter than expected
paragraphs: Nina and her brother plan a short walk through woodland near their guesthouse. At the trail information board, they choose a marked circular route of three kilometres. The path is wet after rain, so they walk slowly and carefully. They stop at a junction to check the yellow arrows rather than follow a narrow unmarked path. The signs lead them towards a small viewpoint above the village.

At the viewpoint, they compare the distance marker with the information board. They discover that they have already completed most of the route. The walk is shorter than Nina expected because the marked route does not include the longer hillside path. They return along the yellow arrows and reach the guesthouse before lunch. Nina describes the walk to the host and explains that the signs were clear and the route was suitable for their chosen pace.
questions: How long is the chosen circular route?
Which colour arrows do they follow?

dialogue: Nina
The board shows a three-kilometre circular walk. Shall we take that one?
На стенде указан трёхкилометровый круговой маршрут. Выберем его?
Brother
Yes. The path is wet, so let's walk carefully.
Да. Тропа мокрая, будем идти осторожно.
Nina
Which way do the yellow arrows point at this junction?
Куда показывают жёлтые стрелки на этой развилке?
Brother
Towards the viewpoint. We should follow the marked path.
К смотровой площадке. Нужно следовать обозначенной тропе.
Nina
We have already walked most of the route. It is shorter than I expected.
Мы уже прошли большую часть маршрута. Он короче, чем я ожидала.
Brother
The longer hillside path is a separate route on the map.
Более длинная тропа по склону — отдельный маршрут на карте.
Nina
Let's return slowly and enjoy the view on the way.
Давай вернёмся не спеша и насладимся видом по дороге.
Brother
Good idea. We'll be back at the guesthouse before lunch.
Хорошая идея. Вернёмся в гостевой дом до обеда.
listening: Which route does the brother say is separate?
The road to the bus station
speaking: Describe a marked trail using both adjectives and adverbs.
Explain why a walker may change their pace.
Give a short spoken account of following yellow arrows.
Compare two fictional walking routes by distance and terrain.
Retell the trip from choosing the path to returning.
writing: Write a description of a circular walk using four manner adverbs.
Write a short message to a friend recommending a marked trail.
Write six adjective/adverb pairs in complete contextual sentences.
pack.model: The path was wet, so we walked carefully. The arrows clearly showed the circular route. It was shorter than we expected.

competency.canDo: Сравнить маршруты и описать пройденный путь.
competency.successCriteria: Distinguish adjective and adverb use and retell a route accurately.

checks: Complete: We did the task ___ (good, adverb).
Two paths meet, but only one has the route marker. Which action fits the described plan?
Check the marked direction before continuing.
Assume the distance marker is always wrong.

pack.title: A picnic moved to the shelter
pack.goal: Обсудить происходящее и обычные действия, адаптировать план.

grammar.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
grammar.rule: Present Simple описывает привычки и устойчивые факты; Present Continuous — происходящее сейчас или временное действие.
grammar.pattern: We usually eat outside / We are eating inside today.
grammar.example: It usually stays dry here, but it is raining now.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори it raining без is.
exercises: It ___ now, so we are moving the picnic.
Complete: We usually ___ (eat) outside in summer.
Скажи: мы сейчас ждём под навесом.
We are waiting under the shelter now
The café ___ at nine every morning.
Complete: She ___ (be, present) carrying the food now.
Скажи: они обычно встречаются у реки.
They usually meet by the river

phrases: We usually have our picnic on the grass.
Обычно мы устраиваем пикник на траве.
It is raining now, so we are moving under the shelter.
Сейчас идёт дождь, поэтому переходим под навес.
Can you carry the waterproof bag to the dry table?
Можешь отнести непромокаемую сумку к сухому столу?
The park shelter is open to visitors today.
Навес в парке сегодня открыт для посетителей.
We are waiting for our friends near the entrance.
Мы ждём друзей возле входа.
I normally bring sandwiches and fruit.
Обычно я приношу сэндвичи и фрукты.
Let's send a message with the new picnic location.
Отправим сообщение с новым местом пикника.
The rain is getting lighter at the moment.
Дождь сейчас ослабевает.
I'll leave the table clean when we finish.
Оставлю стол чистым, когда закончим.
We can go back outside when the grass dries.
Можем вернуться на улицу, когда трава высохнет.

reading.title: A picnic moved to the shelter
paragraphs: Omar and two friends usually meet in a park for a picnic once a month. They choose a table near a small lake and bring food to share. Today, however, a sudden shower begins just as they arrive. One of the friends sees a covered shelter with several tables. The group checks the sign and finds that the shelter is open to visitors.

Omar is carrying the food while his friend is moving the bags to a dry table. The third friend is still on the way, so they send him the new location. They normally eat on the grass, but today they are eating under the shelter. After lunch, the rain becomes lighter. They collect their rubbish, leave the table clean and decide to walk around the lake. They are pleased that a simple change of location allowed the picnic to continue.
questions: How often do the friends usually meet for a picnic?
What do they do after lunch?
Collect rubbish and decide to walk

dialogue: Omar
It is raining now. Shall we move the picnic under that shelter?
Сейчас идёт дождь. Перенесём пикник под тот навес?
Friend
Yes. The sign says the shelter is open today.
Да. На табличке сказано, что навес сегодня открыт.
Omar
I'll carry the food. Can you take the bags to the dry table?
Я понесу еду. Можешь отнести сумки к сухому столу?
Friend
Of course. Our other friend is still walking here.
Конечно. Наш другой друг ещё идёт сюда.
Omar
Let's send him the new location. We usually meet by the lake.
Отправим ему новое место. Обычно встречаемся у озера.
Friend
I've sent it. He is coming to the shelter now.
Я отправил. Сейчас он идёт к навесу.
Omar
The rain is getting lighter, but let's eat here first.
Дождь ослабевает, но сначала поедим здесь.
Friend
Agreed. We'll leave the table clean and walk later.
Согласен. Оставим стол чистым и прогуляемся позже.
listening: Where is the third friend coming now?
speaking: Describe your usual picnic and what is happening differently today.
Use three Present Continuous sentences about people moving items.
Explain a temporary meeting location change to a late friend.
Compare a usual outdoor activity with today's indoor alternative.
Role-play choosing a sheltered place without cancelling the event.
writing: Write a message explaining where the group is waiting now.
Write four habitual and four current-action sentences about a picnic.
Write a brief account of how a rain shower changed a plan.
pack.model: We usually meet by the lake, but it is raining now. We're eating under the shelter. Please come to the dry table near the entrance.

competency.canDo: Обсудить происходящее и обычные действия, адаптировать план.
competency.successCriteria: Contrast habits and temporary actions and explain a live plan change.

checks: She usually ___ tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
Complete: They ___ (be, present) waiting outside now.
A group moves to a new picnic location while one friend is travelling. What information should they send?

pack.title: A photograph for the walking club
pack.goal: Попросить разрешение на фотографию и рассказать о снимке.

grammar.title: Object pronouns and polite permission
grammar.rule: Object pronouns: me, you, him, her, it, us, them после глагола или предлога. Can I...? / Could I...? — просьба о разрешении.
grammar.pattern: take a photo of us / send it to her
grammar.example: Could you send the photograph to me?
grammar.pitfall: Не говори send it to I: to me.
exercises: Could you send the photo to ___?
Complete: The photos belong to Anna and Leo. Send them to ___.
Can you take a photo of ___ together?
Complete: The picture is ready. Could you show ___ to me?
Скажи: мы можем показать им снимок.
We can show them the picture

phrases: Could you take a photograph of us by the bridge?
Можете сфотографировать нас возле моста?
May I share this photograph in our private club album?
Можно поделиться этой фотографией в закрытом альбоме клуба?
Please send it to me before posting it publicly.
Пришлите мне её до публичной публикации.
Does everyone agree to appear in the group picture?
Все согласны попасть на групповую фотографию?
I can send the landscape photo to them instead.
Могу вместо этого отправить им пейзажную фотографию.
She prefers not to be in photographs on public pages.
Она предпочитает не появляться на фото публичных страниц.

reading.title: A photograph for the walking club
paragraphs: Vera joins a small walking club on a Sunday morning. At the end of the walk, the organiser suggests taking a group photograph beside a bridge. Most people agree, but one member says that she prefers not to appear in photographs on public pages. The organiser thanks her for explaining and asks whether she would like to stand outside the picture. She chooses to do so.

Another walker takes the photograph and shows it to the group. The organiser asks whether everyone in the picture agrees to share it in the private club album. He does not assume that permission for a private album also allows a public post. Vera asks for a copy and offers to write a short caption about the route. Later, the organiser shares a landscape photograph on the public page instead of the group picture.
